articles.title_kr: 미얀마 불교의례의 성립과 전개 연구 ― 재가자의 참회 의식 가도의 성립과 변용에 대하여 ―
articles.title_en: A study on the establishment and development of Buddhist rituals in Myanmar ― About the Establishment and Transformation of the Layman's Confession Ritual Gadaw ―
articles.abstract_kr: This thesis is a study on the Gadaw ceremony, one of the yearly rituals performed after the full moon of the Month of Thadingyut in the Buddhist society of Myanmar. Originally, ‘Gadaw’ has a dictionary meaning of ‘to worship or confess a mistake’, but the Myanmar people have transformed this Gadaw into a special type of ritual that adds repentance to the rite of worship and passed it down. In other words, the Gadaw ceremony is a ritual that refers to the act of asking for forgiveness for one's wrongdoings committed with body, speech, and intention over the past year while offering respect and gratitude to superiors on a specific day.This Gadaw ceremony is characterized by the fact that Lay Buddhists perform it at nearby temples, homes, schools, or workplaces after Pavāranā, which is performed by Myanmar monks after completing a three-month vassa. In other words, just as a monk asks his colleague(avuso) about his wrongdoing in body, speech, and intention during the vassa period, and repents if there is a mistake, so that all together achieve a pure Sangha, Lay Buddhists also use the same method to ask for forgiveness from their superiors or elders for their wrongdoings in the past year.At this time, the object of repentance is not only for the subordinates or youngers, but also for the superiors or elders, and through mutual forgiveness and repentance for each other's mistakes, the Buddhist society of Myanmar has maintained a healthy community. As such, the Gadaw ceremony is a very important Buddhist practice of Lay Buddhists passed down as a means of strengthening Buddhist values and promoting social solidarity in Myanmar.This paper is a study on the role and social transformation of the Gadaw ritual established as a means of sound social integration in the process of establishing and developing Buddhist rituals in Myanmar.Through this study, it aims to revive the beautiful customs of respect and courtesy for the elderly, which are disappearing from Korean Buddhist society, and to find ways to maintain a healthy social community by incorporating it into Korean Buddhist society.

articles.title_kr: 신이 서사와 영이 서사의 대립과 견제 ― 『삼국유사』 신화 읽기의 한 시각 ―
articles.title_en: Confrontation and controlling of a sacred narrative and marvelous narrative
articles.abstract_kr: Three dimensions of myths appear in “Samgukyusa”. There is a myth of the third dimension created by the interaction between the two, the first dimension of sacred narrative, and the second dimension of marvelous narrative. Until now, the history of Korean mythology has interpreted only the sacred narrative in Samgukyusa as a myth. This is the result of narrow mythology accepted through Japanese translation. Now, it is necessary to expand the myth not only to a story about gods, but also to a story about "difference" events that are difficult to happen in reality.The mainstream of sacred narrative in Samgukyusa is the myth of founding and kingship. As can be seen from the records of the origins of the ancestors of the 6 tribes of Silla, the progenitor myth is placed in relation to the founding myth. This is because “Samgukyusa” records the sacred narrative of three kingdoms. The second half of “Samgukyusa”, which begins with "Heungbeop chapter," consists of a Buddhist spiritual story, which was conceptualized to as the marvelous narrative corresponding to the sacred narrative. The marvelous narrative is a myth in that it reproduces events created during the introduce and settlement of Buddhism as unusual and spiritual stories that cannot be experienced in everyday life. This is because myths are sacred stories and ideologies in the form of stories.However, as can be seen in the case of "Kim Hyun-gam-ho", the marvelous narrative continues the worldview of Jatabulyi[自他不二] in the progenitor myth, but reconstructs it into a view of time of three lives.In the world view of the progenitor myth, the killing of animals is possible only when animals give themselves as gifts. On the other hand, Buddhism, which occurred after the state, says that even if animals are killed, they can be rewarded in the life after death from the end by building good deed. Through this discourse strategy, “Samgukyusa” forms a compilation so that the worldview sacred narrative and marvelous narrative can be balanced with each other by checking the sacred narrative as a mandate from Heaven. This discourse is a myth that works in the third dimension of “Samgukyusa”.

articles.title_kr: 『삼국유사』의 은사와 일사 ― 「避隱」편과 관련하여 ―
articles.title_en: Hermits in Overlooked Historical Record
articles.abstract_kr: 이 논문에서는 은사와 일사의 삶이 모습이 무엇이며 어떤 것인가에대해 구명한 글이다. 논자는 『삼국유사』(5권 9편 138조목)에 실린 은사와 일사의 전수(全數) 조사 아래 「피은」편과 이외의 편에 실린 은사와 일사의 삶과 의미에 대해 살펴보았다. 「피은」과 「피은」 이외편의 은사와 일사는 우리의 삶에서 물러남과 나아감 혹은 숨음과드러남의 참다운 의미가 무엇이며 그 의미는 어디에서 실현되어야하는지를 시사해 주어 왔다.종래에 우리는 세간적 출사와 출세간의 출가 무대를 다르게 인식해왔다. 하지만 물러남과 나아감, 숨음과 드러남의 경계에서는 세간적 삶과 출세간적 삶의 무대가 다르지 않다. 세간의 출사자는 임금을 위하여 충성을 다하는 근왕(勤王)의 삶을 살아야 하고, 출세간의출가자는 출세간의 수행적 삶을 살면서 출출세간의 이타적 삶을 실천해야 하기 때문이다.대개 우리는 중도에 대한 무지에서 비롯된 ‘불만족의 삶’과 연기에대한 무명에서 비롯된 ‘불안정의 앎’으로 고통스러운 일상을 살고있다. 어떻게 해야 우리는 이같은 불만족의 삶과 불안정의 앎에서벗어날 수 있을까? 붓다는 사성제의 이해와 팔정도의 실천을 통해존재에 대한 안정의 앎과 현실에 대한 만족의 삶의 통로를 열어주었다. 고통의 굴레에서 벗어나는 해탈의 길과 영원히 자유로운 걸림 없는 열반의 길은 서로 이어진다. 해탈은 우리의 앎을 자유롭게해 주고, 열반은 우리의 삶을 자재롭게 해주기 때문이다.『삼국유사』가 보여주는 은사와 일사의 삶은 시종일관 이름 세 글자의 겉껍데기에 목숨을 걸고 사는 출사자와 출가자에게 허명과 허상을 일깨워 준다. 은사와 일사는 이름 세 글자를 벗어나야 해탈적앎을 얻을 수 있고, 이름 세 글자를 버려야 열반적 삶을 살 수 있음을 시사해 주고 있다. 해탈은 자유에 닿아있고 열반은 자재에 닿아있다. 이 때문에 해탈의 앎과 열반의 삶은 소통될 수 있는 것이다.지성적 앎과 지성적 삶도 마찬가지이다.일연이 『삼국유사』의 여러 편목에서 보여주고자 했던 것은 중도 자비의 삶과 연기 지혜의 앎의 소통이었다. 고려 후기 전란 당시의지식인들의 모습은 기대에 미치지 못하였다. 그래서 그는 고대 사국의 역사에서 지성적 삶을 보여준 고승 즉 성사를 ① 은사 일사로서의 삶, ② 풍류 도인으로서의 삶, ③ 국사 왕사로서의 삶으로 보여주었다. 이러한 지성들의 삶의 모습은 『섭대승론석』의 구절처럼“출세출세법은 세간법을 치유하는 법이고, 출출세법은 출세법을 치료하는 법이다”고 한 것에서 알 수 있듯이 물러남과 나아감은 출세간법의 치유와 출출세법 즉 입세법의 치료가 부처와 보살의 자비행의 다른 표현임을 알 수 있게 한다.개인과 공인, 즉 사적 인간과 공적 인간의 지향과 취향은 동일하지않다. 하지만 국난에 접하게 되면 그 지향과 취향은 만날 수밖에없다. 무엇보다도 전쟁에서 살아남아야 하기 때문이다. 또 우리가역사 속에서 지성적 삶을 담보하려면 역사 위에서 법력을 기르며살아야만 한다. 법력은 불법의 위력이자 진리 수행을 통해 터득한지혜의 힘이기 때문이다. 고승 즉 성사는 진리 수행을 통해 불법의위력을 터득한 존재이자 진리에 대한 확신을 통해 불법의 위력을자기화한 존재라고 할 수 있다. 이들은 「피은」과 「피은」 이외의 편목에서 물러남과 나아감 혹은 숨음과 드러남을 통해 ‘은사’와 ‘일사’ 의 참다운 ...

articles.title_kr: 『삼국유사』의 음악과 악기
articles.title_en: The Music and musical instruments in the book Samgukyusa
articles.abstract_kr: Some musical instruments found their way from the Song Dynasty of China to Silla because the Samgukyusa was written 170 years after Munmyo Jeryeak had been introduced to Korea. Also, since this was the time of the Mongol invasion, Ilyeon's desire for the national defense of Goryeo was contained in Samgukyusa and told through of the story of Silla.The contents of Wonhyo's Muaega, Wolmyeong's Dosolga and Jemangmaega, and the story of the Chanting Master each focus on the supernatural power and influence of Buddhism. While Samguksagi describes musical content and facts, Samgukyusa expresses the hearts of the Silla people through music rather than the music itself. This fact was clearly revealed in the Cheoyongga(處容歌) and Dosolga(兜率歌) of Ven Wolmyeong, as well as the Manpasikjeok(萬波息笛) and Geomungo(玄琴), which are included in both the Samgukyusa and the Samguksagi. In the Samgukyusa, Ven Ilyeon never once used the word Gayageum (加耶琴). Mulgyeja's 琴 and King Wonseong's 12-string, and Ureuk's gayageum are of the same family, but the 玄琴 (geomungo) is not same the structure and playing method. Therefore, it is incorrect to write the character 琴 of Mulgyeja as geomungo. Also, the translation of Ven Wolmyeong's 笛 as oboe is not appropriate. This is because the oboe was played with a reed that did not exist in Silla. When translating Chinese instrument names in the ancient literature into Korean, unlike instruments such as 瑟, 琵琶, and 阮咸, 琴 is included in 月琴, 洋琴, 7絃 琴, 12絃琴, and 玄琴. Thus the lineage and historical background of the instrument must be examined.The story of Cha-Deukgong, who pretended to be an ordinary man and carried a Bipa, can give off an effect similar in status to the guitar in the Korean pop music scene of the 1970s and 80s. The story of the constant playing of the pipe organ 笙 and singing of songs about town indicates the rich musical life of the Silla people. In all of the Samgukyusa and Samguksagi, there is nothing about Ven Jingam's Buddhist chant Beompae. It may be considered surprising that there is nothing about it in the Samgukyusa, which focuses on Buddhist content
keywords_en: Music of Silla and Goryeo Dynasty

articles.title_kr: 『삼국유사』의 가족과 여성
articles.title_en: Family and Woman in Samgukyusa
articles.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 『삼국유사』의 가족과 여성에 관한 기사들을 전수조사 형식으로 검토하여 논의를 전개하였다. 그러나 가족과 여성의 범위가넓어서 본 논문에서는 그 범위를 한정하여 살펴보았다. 우선 가족내에는 여러 관계 들이 존재하고 있으나 이 연구에서는 가족 형성과정에서 중요한 요소인 결혼 선택의 조건과 가족 유형의 특징을중심으로 살펴보았다.한편 여성의 경우 성행동과 재산권을 통해 살펴보았다. 사회 제도로서의 결혼은 기존의 사회체계 내에서 작동하는 제 권력 관계의반영인데 특히 재산과 성이라는 문제와 연관되어 나타나기 때문이다.우선 결혼 선택의 조건을 내용 분석하여 범주화한 결과 인성의 측면을 강조한 사례가 가장 많았고, 신체적 특성과 외모, 정치적 이익, 연령, 능력, 은혜 갚음의 순으로 언급이 되었다. 이 중에서 특이한 점은 남녀 모두 아름다움에 대한 기록들이 많이 보였는데 신라 시대의 사람들이 아름다움에 대해 깊이 매혹되어있는 것 같다는 연구들과 맥을 같이 하고 있다. 그러나 사례가 적거나 언급이 안 된 경우는추후 다른 자료와의 비교 검토를 통해 보완할 필요가 있다.삼국유사의 가족 유형을 내용 분석하여 한부모가족(母子가족), 다문화가족(국제혼), 재혼 가족 등으로 범주화하여 각각의 특징을 논의하였다. 이 부분 역시 다른 자료와의 비교 검토를 통해 더욱 보완할필요가 있다.한편 성행동 및 재산권을 통해서 살펴본 여성의 기록 중 우선 성행동의 기록을 통해 알 수 있었던 것은 ’아버지가 없는 자식‘ 에 방점이 찍히는 것이 아니고, 어머니의 자식이라는 자기충족적 존재로서의 여성의 모습이 그려져 있었다는 점이다. 즉 혼전 성행동을 통해임신을 한 후에도 결혼이라는 제도 밖에서 아이를 키우거나 자유연애를 통해 결혼을 하는 등 성행동에 있어서 한쪽이 힘을 가지고 다른 한쪽을 일방적으로 규제하는 사회적 분위기가 아니었음을 추정해 볼 수 있다. 이러한 점은 결혼 외의 성행동 사례에서도 마찬가지로 드러났다.여성의 재산권과 관련된 기록에서는 왕족부터 가난한 여인에 이르기까지 자신의 재산을 소유하고 쓸수 있다는 것을 보여주고 있다.삼국유사에 많은 여성 관련 이야기가 수록되어 있는 이유는 편찬자일연이 살았던 고려사회의 특징들, 즉 서류부가혼(婿留婦家婚) 이혼과 재혼의 자유로움, 남녀의 재산 균분상속 등 그 시대의 상황들이반영된 것으로 추측할 수 있다.본 논문에서 논의하지 못한 삼국유사에서 보여주는 가족의 여러 하위 체계들과 여성의 모습을 다양한 측면에서 재조명할 필요가 있다. 가족과 여성의 통섭적 연구를 위해 다른 자료 등을 통해서 비교하고 보완해 간다면 삼국유사의 기록에 대해 깊이 있는 해석이 이루어지리라고 생각한다.

articles.title_kr: 『삼국유사』 속 명절·제의와 음식
articles.title_en: Food for holidays and rituals in Samgukyusa
articles.abstract_kr: The paper examines the festivals, ancestral rites, and cuisine depicted in Samgukyusa. It particularly focuses on Ogiil(烏忌日) and Jungyangil(重陽 日), exploring how these festivals initially began with ritualistic characteristics but gradually evolved and weakened, eventually settling into secular customs.The study begins by investigating the origins and food associated with the representative festival, Jungwol Daeboreum. It delves into the transformation of Ogiil into a festive event through the lens of Sagumgap(射 琴匣) in the context of Ogiil, and the evolving process of Na-ban(糯飯, glutinous rice) from a form of rice associated with Ogiil into a symbolic representation of plain and medicinal foods. While the common interpretation of Ogiil's glutinous rice is akin to contemporary medicinal food, the paper scrutinizes the documented transformation and distinguishes the differences between Na-ban, Yak-ban(藥飯), and Hyang-ban(香飯).Additionally, through the Gyeongdeokwang Chungdamsa Pyohondaeduk (景德王 忠談師 表訓大德), the paper explores the transformation of Jungyangjeol from a Buddhist ritual during the Silla era into a secular festival. It also investigates the origins of the tea ceremony(茶禮) in the ceremonial practices at Chungdamsa. Finally, by analyzing a passage from the GaRakGukGi(駕洛國記), which provides insights into the ingredients and types of food in the ancestral rites of Silla during that era, the study aims to uncover the relationship between food culture, Buddhism, and the festival of Samjinnal.The author hopes that this paper, by examining not only festival and ancestral rites but also various food-related articles in Samgukyusa, will provide a foundation for research aiming to reconstruct the dietary habits of Silla.

articles.title_kr: 최치원의 사산비명(四山碑銘)에 나타난 불교 인식
articles.title_en: Choi Chi-won's Perception of Buddhism shown in Sasanbimyeong (四山碑銘)
articles.abstract_kr: This paper examined Choi Chi-won's perception of Buddhism, focusing on Sasanbimyeong (四山碑銘). Choi Chi-won's perception of Buddhism shown in Sasanbimyeong can be largely divided into a comparative perception with Confucianism outside of Buddhism and an understanding of the relationship between Seon (禪) and Gyo (敎) within Buddhism. And Choi Chi-won's perception of Buddhism changes over time as he completes each inscription.Initially, Choi Chi-won viewed Buddhism and Confucianism as equals and emphasized that their teachings are not different from each other.Then he gradually began to give priority to Buddhism and eventually tried to integrate Confucianism into Buddhism. In other words, Choi Chi-won perceived that Buddhism and Confucianism were the same in terms of their teachings, but that ultimately Buddhism was superior to Confucianism. Meanwhile, within Buddhism, he understood the relationship between Seon and Gyo from the Buddhist perspective of dependent arising (緣起). In the early inscription of Sasanbimyeong, Seon was considered more essential than Gyo, but afterwards, he understood the relationship between Seon and Gyo as a systemic interdependent relationship and said that Seon and Gyo are not different from each other ultimately.In conclusion, Choi Chi-won's Sasanbimyeong reveals a comparative perception of Buddhism with Confucianism, which gives priority to Buddhism, and an understanding of the interdependent relationship between Seon and Gyo, which states that they are not different from each other. Choi Chi-won's perception of Buddhism shown in Sasanbimyeong is of great value in that it serves as a starting point for his writings on Buddhism throughout his life.
keywords_en: comparative perception of Buddhism and Confucianism
understanding of Seon (禪) and Gyo (敎

articles.title_kr: 태고 보우의 인가와 전법에 대한 고찰
articles.title_en: A study on Taego-Bowoo's Certification of Enlightenment and to Receive the Transmitted Dharma by a zen master Shiwu-qinggong
articles.abstract_kr: The late Goryeo zen master Taego-Bowoo has been notable in many aspects in the history of Korean Zen Buddhism. He is the successor of the patriarch-zen originating from Bodhidharma, the attempt to renew the aspect of the Korea Zen sect toward the integration of the nine mountain of zen school, and the practice of zen master verbally transmits the Dharma(面授口訣) to his disciple and the heir to a mantle of Dharma(嗣法) as Linjizong's successors.As a result, Taego-Bowoo received the certification of enlightenment and a zen master verbally transmits the Dharma of Linjizong in China from Shiwu-qinggong(石屋淸珙) for his enlightenment in Goryeo, and was able to convey a blood-vessel(血脈) I.e. a genealogy of the transmission of the Buddha's Dharma to Goryeo.The tradition of the certification of enlightenment(印可) and to receive the transmitted Dharma(傳法) of zen masters of the previous era was Zen Buddhism before the silla period was formed, and the tradition of the certification of enlightenment and to receive the transmitted Dharma of Taego-Bowoo was different in that it was a forest species.In particular, after experiencing personal practice and enlightenment in Korea, pursuing the admirable zen masters and acquiring traditional the certification of enlightenment and to receive the transmitted Dharma(傳 法) for enlightenment from Yuan's Shiwu-qinggong, Taego-Bowoo contributed greatly to the history of Korean Zen Buddhism. This is why Taego-Bowoo crossed the sea and entered Yuan.
keywords_en: the heir to a mantle of Dharma

articles.title_kr: 명(明) 태조(太祖)의  불교정책과 불교계의 대응
articles.title_en: The Ming Taizu's Buddhist Policy and  the Buddhist Community's Response
articles.abstract_kr: 중국불교는 명대(明代)에 이르러 승려 출신으로 황제가 된 태조 주원장(朱元璋)의 철저한 불교 통제 정책으로 인하여 그 생존의 갈림길에 서게 되었다. 태조는 송대(宋代)의 승관제(僧官制)를 계승하여승록사(僧錄司)를 설치하여 더욱 철저하게 도첩(度牒)을 관리하였고, 승려들을 선(禪), 강(講), 교(敎)로 나누어 승복의 복색(服色)을 구분하였다. 나아가 승려와 일반인의 교류를 금하는 등 철저한 불교의 통제 정책을 실행하였다. 그러나 태조의 사후 ‘정난의 역’으로 황제가된 영락제(永樂帝)에 이르러서는 태조의 정책은 완화되어 불교가 유지될 수 있게 되었다. 그런데 영락제는 자신이 황제가 되기 위하여 불교를 이용하였는데, 그것이 바로 ‘인효황후몽감불설(仁孝皇后夢感 佛說)’이다. 그것은 영락제의 부인인 인효황후가 꿈속에서 관세음보살로부터 경전을 받았으며, 그 경전에 영락제가 황제가 되어야 하는 정당성이 담겨있다는 것이다. 이러한 ‘정난의 역’과 인효황후의‘몽감불설’은 도연(道衍) 선사의 건의로 이루어졌다고 하겠다.본 논문에서는 이러한 태조의 불교정책과 ‘인효황후몽감불설’, 그리고 ‘정난의 역’에서의 도연의 역할을 고찰하였으며, 또한 도연의 불교사상과 후대의 평가를 고찰하였다
articles.abstract_en: Chinese Buddhism came to a crossroads in its survival during the Ming Dynasty due to the strict Buddhist control policy of Taejo Zhu Yuanzhang (朱元璋), a former monk who became emperor. Emperor Taejo inherited the Song Dynasty's monk-bureaucrat system and established the Sēnglùsī (僧錄司) to manage the Dùdié (度牒) more thoroughly, and to teach monks Zen, lectures, and teachings. The colors of monks’ uniforms were divided into classes. Furthermore, a thorough Buddhist control policy was implemented, including prohibiting interaction between monks and the general public. However, by the time of Emperor Yǒnglè (永樂帝), who became emperor as a result of the ‘Jìng nàn zhī biàn (靖難之變)’ after Taejo’s death, Taejo’s policies were relaxed and Buddhism was able to be maintained. However, Emperor Yǒnglè used Buddhism to become emperor, and that is the ‘Empress Rénxiào’s Dreaming of Buddhas (仁孝皇 后夢感佛說)’. It is said that Empress Rénxiào (仁孝皇后), the wife of Emperor Yǒnglè, received a sutra from Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara in a dream, and that the sutra contained the justification for Emperor Yǒnglè to become emperor. However, it can be said that ‘Jìng nàn zhī biàn’ and ‘Empress Rénxiào’s Dreaming of Buddhas’ were created at the suggestion of Zen Master Dào yǎn (道衍).In this paper, we examined Taejo's Buddhist policy, Dào yǎn's role in ‘Empress Rénxiào’s Dreaming of Buddhas’, and ‘Jìng nàn zhī biàn’, and also examined Dào yǎn's Buddhist thoughts and later evaluations.
keywords_kr: Jìng nàn zhī biàn(靖難之變)
keywords_en: Empress Rénxiào’s Dreaming of Buddhas (仁孝皇后夢感佛說)

articles.title_kr: 정혜(定慧)법사의 ‘생활선(生活禪)’ 이념과 수행법
articles.title_en: The Ideology and Practice of Jinghui’s Life Zen
articles.abstract_kr: Buddhist priest Jinghui established the character of modern Chinese Buddhism by advocating ‘Life Seon’ with the end of ‘A Life of Enlightenment·A Life of Dedication’. The ‘Life Seon’ inherits the tradition of the Seon Masters, Huìnéng·Mazu·Zhàozhōu, and develops the ideology of ‘humanistic Buddhism’ advocated by modern Chinese Buddhist priest Tàixū.Jinghui inherited his teacher, Xūyún, restored Buddhist Lineage of Chinese Seon Buddhism, and rebuilt numerous ruined temples. In addition, he made an effort to realize Mahayana Buddhism and the spirit of Seon thought in the concrete living world of modern people. In particular, he emphasized the promotion of Buddhist studies and spreading Dharma through academics, and also focused on cultivating young Buddhist people through the ‘Summer Camp for Life Seon’.This paper deals with the ideology, practice, action, characteristics, and significance of Jinghui’s ‘Life Seon’, which represents the characteristics 원고접수: 2023-12-06 심사완료: 2023-12-20 게재확정: 2023-12-22 310 한국불교사연구_제24호(2023.12.31) and ideas of modern Chinese Buddhism. Dinghui saw that the characteristic of Buddhist dharma was to conform to the truth and apply it according to the times. He also argued that Seon was the only bridge between Buddhism and modern society. ‘Life Seon’ is the way to complete enlightenment and liberation in the present life, and it advocates that the practice of enlightenment and mercy must be carried out in accordance with the specific way of life of modern people. Through this, ‘Life Seon’ has its characteristics and significance in that it presented a clear direction for Chinese Buddhism to move forward.

articles.title_kr: 탈종교화시대의 포교활동 방향에 대한 고찰 ― 군불교의 사례를 중심으로 ―
articles.title_en: A Study on direction of missionary activities in the age of de-religion
articles.abstract_kr: Drop in the religious population amid turbulent society changes after COVID-19, is dimming the future prospect of Korean Buddhism. Paradigm shift is required in many aspects, including the actual military Buddhism event sites.It is a time that we need to strategically think about how we will have to change, develop our missionary act in accordance to the era of transformation. Especially, analyzing and setting a strategy in the military Buddhism which takes the core in youth missionary act, is a key task that will help us predict the future of korea buddhism.We need to analyze soldier's perception, and apply it to military missionary act. By doing so, we also have to change, develop our practice and methodology in accordance with the social changes. Rather than persisting on tradition and forms, missionary act should be flexible, which can reflect changes and evolve at the same time.Through this study, I would like to understand the phenomenon of atheistic population surge in the society, and it's effect on the field of missionary acts. Through this, I aim to provide how the missionary strategy should be established to best deal with the reforming society

articles.title_kr: 성격 5요인이 팔정도에 미치는 영향
articles.title_en: The Effects of the five personality factors on the Eightfold Path
articles.abstract_kr: This paper analyzes the impact of the five personality factors on the Eightfold Path through empirical statistics. For this purpose, a self-administered questionnaire was administered to 350 men and women. Among the subjects analyzed, 51.8% were men and 44.0% were women. Those in their 50s or older accounted for the most at 41.0%, followed by those in their 50s and 40s at 30.2% and 10.5%, respectively.The most common religion was Buddhism at 38.5%, followed by none at 35.2%. A total of 80 questions were created, with 10 questions each for 8 degrees, and the survey was conducted on a 5-point Likert scale.As a result of factor analysis of 10 questions for each of the 8 degrees, affairs were classified into 3 sub-factors and the remaining 7 were classified into 2 factors each. When the internal reliability of the sub-factors was calculated, the Cronbach's alpha of Factor 2, Factor 1, and Factor 2 were excluded from further analysis as Cronbach's alpha was less than 0.7. When the impact of the 5 personality factors on the Eightfold Path was confirmed through path analysis, neuroticism had a statistically significant negative influence on the 1 factor of positive attitude with an unstandardized coefficient of –0.363±0.056 and significance probability p=0.005. On the other hand, openness and conscientiousness had a statistically significant positive (+) influence with unstandardized coefficients of 0.278 ± 0.090 (p=0.002) and 0.136 ± 0.067 (p=0.042), respectively. Neuroticism has a statistically significant negative (–) effect on the factors. And openness had a statistically significant positive (+) effect not only on political views 1, but also on political views 2, political affairs 1, political affairs 3, political words 1, positive sentiments 1, positive sentiments 1, positive sentiments 2, and political views 1. Sincerity is a statistically significant positive (+) for Jeongsa 1, Jeongmyeong 1, Jeongyeo 2, Jeongup 1, Jeongmyeong 1, Jeongmyeong 2, Jeongjeongjin 1, Jeongjeongjin 2, Jeongnyeom 1, Jeongmyeong 2, Jeongmyeong 1, and Jeongjeong2 along with Jeong View 1. was having an impact. Extroversion had a statistically significant positive (+) effect on Jeongsa 1, Jeongsa 3, Jeongseo 1, Jeongseo 2, and Jeongup 2, and agreeableness had a statistically significant positive influence on Jeongseo 1, Jeongmyeong 2, Jeongmyeong 2, and Jeongjeong 2. Overall, neuroticism had a negative effect on the Eightfold Path, while openness and sincerity had a positive effect. And it was analyzed that extroversion and agreeableness have a slight positive effect.This study may have a religious bias, with Buddhists accounting for over 38.5% and those with no religion accounting for 35.2%, while Christians and Catholics accounted for a combined 17.7%. However, it is significant as the first study to empirically analyze the impact of personality traits on the 8th degree. It is believed that empirical research on other Buddhist doctrines and theories besides the Eightfold Path will be possible in the future. And comparative studies among religious people will be possible.

articles.title_kr: 실상산문의 인물과 사상
articles.title_en: The Characters and Ideas of Silsangsan School
articles.abstract_kr: This paper reveals the characters and ideas of Silsangsan school, one of the Nine Mountain Seon schools in the late Silla and early Goryeo era. Hong-cheok studied abroad in Tang Dynasty to learn Seon and came back. After that, he founded Silsangsa Temple in Jirisan Mountain and re-established Silsangsan school and his dharma lineage was handed down to Su-cheol. Silsangsan school has a solid status as the first Seon School among the Nine Mountain Seon schools in the history of Korean Seon order.In fact, the researches so far on the characters and ideas of Silsangsan school can be summarized as follows.First, Silsangsan school founder, Hong-cheok succeeded to Seodang -Jijang, a disciple of Seon master Majo-Doil. Second, the characteristic of Hong-cheok’s Seon thought is “to cultivate but nothing to cultivate, to enlighten but nothing to enlighten.” Third, Hong-cheok’s Seon training method led to Su-cheol and Pyeon-woon.Through a critical review of the existing perception, this paper presented the ideological characteristics of Silsangsan school and the unresolved challenges related to the succession of Hong-cheok’s Seon training method. In particular, by raising the limitations of the primary data, errors in interpretation by previous researchers, the formation of Silsangsan school, and the issue of its identity, a task was presented on how to approach the research on Seon thought of the Nine Mountain Seon schools in the future.

articles.title_kr: 성주산문의 인물과 사상
articles.title_en: The Study on the Character and Thought of Sungju-san School
articles.abstract_kr: This paper analyzed the characters and ideas of the Sungju-san School. If you organize the results, you will see the following be summed up. First of all, Nanghyemuyeom(낭혜무염) was regarded as a person who had been demoted from the sacred bone. Such status is called “Deugnan(得難)”. These Deugnan(得難) suggested a new status, one higher than the Yukdupum(육두품). Second, Nanghyemuyeom understood ‘Zen Thought’ of Majo-Doil(馬祖道一). Third, it is believed that the forces that supported Nanghyemuyeom were the royal family of Silla and the aristocrats of the central government.
keywords_kr: 성주산문. 낭혜무염. 득난. 육두품. 마조도일. 선사상
keywords_en: Sungju-san School(성주산문). Nanghyemuyeom(낭혜무염). Deugnan (得難). Yukdupum(육두품). Majo-Doil(馬祖道一). Zen Thought(선사상)

articles.title_kr: 봉림산문의 인물과 사상
articles.title_en: Characters and Thoughts of Bongrimsanmun
articles.abstract_kr: The topic of this article is to examine the representative characters of Bongrimsanmun, Hyeonwook(787~868), Simhee(855~923), Chanyu(869~ 958), and Chungdam(869~940). Hyeonwook is the teacher of Simhee, who founded Bongrimsanmun. Hyeonwook lived in Hyemoksan Mountain in Yeoju since around 940 after studying in China. It was presumed that the reason why Hyeonwook moved to Hyemoksan Mountain was at the request of the royal family.Sim Hee was the state secretary of Silla. Simhee is Hyunwook’s student.Sim Hee stayed at Bongrimsa Temple in Gimhae in the latter half of her life and opened Bongrimsanmun. After opening Bongnimsanmun, Sim Hee actively worked to stabilize the Silla royal family. When Sim Hee died, King Gyeongmyeong of Silla personally wrote the inscription on the monument for him. This is intended to increase Silla's authority by borrowing Simhui's reputation.Chungdam was a disciple of Simhee and became the abbot of Heungbeopsa Temple in Wonju after returning from studying abroad.Chungdam became the king's teacher and actively helped the Goryeo royal family run stably. When Chungdam died, Taejo Wang Geon personally wrote the epitaph on his monument for him.Chanyu was also Simhee's student. After Chanyu went to China to study, he met King Taejo Wang Geon and became the head priest of Cheonwangsa Temple. Chanyu did not stay at Cheonwangsa Temple for long and moved to Godalsa Temple. In the main text, the reason was interpreted as a change in the power of noble families in the Gwangju region and was seen as being related to the power struggle between Hyejong and the Chungju Yu family. The main characters of Bongrimsanmun can all be said to be practical intellectuals representing their time.

articles.title_kr: 7세기 신라인의 불교 수행 대중화의 원동력
articles.title_en: The driving force behind the popularization of Buddhist practice in Silla in the 7th century
articles.abstract_kr: This research aims to elucidate ‘the driving forces behind the successful popularization of Pure Land practices’ by the public preacher-monks, led by Wonhyo, within the context of 7th-century Silla society's ‘the popularization of Buddhist practice.’ This research was initiated because existing theories on the ‘success of popularization’ remain focused on the propagation activities of Wonhyo and related preacher-monks. Recent studies on the causal narratives in the 『Vajrasamādhi-Sutra』 and 『Exposition of the Vajrasamādhi Sūtra』 suggest that these texts were established after ‘the formation of Silla’ and during the reigns of King Muyeol to King Munmu. Considering these aspects, by cross-analyzing the causal narratives in the 『Vajrasamādhi-Sutra』 and 『Exposition of the Vajrasamādhi Sūtra』 and the related historical sources in the 『Samgukyusa』, it is possible to move beyond the linear existing theories and establish more complex, multilayered, and three-dimensional theories.According to the content of the 『Samgukyusa』, Buddhism at that time had become so widespread that even the illiterate poor were familiar with ‘Namu AmitāBhātya.’ The pervasive belief that ‘anyone can achieve enlightenment’ (如來藏, 一味, 本覺, 一心) was prevalent. This can be attributed to the active and effective propagation methods of preacher-monks such as Hyegong, Dae'an, and Wonhyo. The reason their methods were able to spread throughout Silla was not only due to the efforts of a few exceptional monks but also because of other contributing factors.An analysis of the causal narratives in the 『Vajrasamādhi-Sutra』 and 『Exposition of the Vajrasamādhi Sūtra』 reveals the driving forces behind the effective dissemination of their propagation methods. The public preacher-monks, who initially spread their teachings in the marketplaces, rose from being marginalized monks to becoming central figures in the monastic order through their alliance with royal authority. Wonhyo, for instance, lectured on the 『Exposition of the Vajrasamādhi Sūtra』 at Hwangnyongsa, the highest state temple, and together with other public preacher-monks, played a significant role in the national projects of compiling scriptures and related treatises. Their activities likely created a profound impact and garnered enthusiastic support and interest from the public in Silla society. The 『Vajrasamādhi-Sutra』 and 『Exposition of the Vajrasamādhi Sūtra』 embodies the egalitarian principle of ‘the interpenetration of the two kinds of awakening’ (二覺圓通), which asserts the unity of original and the initial enlightenment. From the perspective of the public preacher-monks, the compilation of this scripture during the reigns of King Muyeol to King Munmu, who sought to legitimize the royal succession, provided an opportunity to propagate the idea that anyone can achieve enlightenment’ (佛性思想, egalitarianism).After the reigns of King Muyeol and King Munmu, records in the 『Samgukyusa』 indicate that even the lowest social classes, such as a slave Ukmyun, were engaging in chanting and achieving immediate enlightenment(現身性佛). This suggests the explosive spread of Pure Land Buddhism. A key factor in this successful popularization was the dedicated efforts of public preacher-monks like Wonhyo. The ‘accelerated momentum of this popularization’ can be attributed to their ‘alliance with the highest ruling authority, the royal court.’
keywords_en: Exposition of the Vajrasamādhi Sūtra (金剛三昧經論)
Interpenetration of the Two Kinds of Awakening(二覺圓通)

articles.title_kr: 당대(唐代) 유종원(柳宗元)· 유우석(劉禹錫)의 유불융합(儒佛融合)
articles.title_en: Convergence between Confucianism and Buddhism by Liu Zong-yuan and Liu Yu-xi in Tang Dynasty
articles.abstract_kr: This paper examines the thought of ‘Convergence between Confucianism and Buddhism’ advocated by LiuZongYuan and LiuYuXi in the Tang Dynasty.Accordingly, this paper first discusses the changes in Buddhism and Confucianism after the ‘Anshi(安史) Rebellion’. After the Anshi Rebellion, the mainstream of Chinese Buddhism was the Northern Chan of the Shenxiu (神秀) lineage, and then the Southern Chan of the Huineng(慧能) lineage became the mainstream. This is because Heze Shenhui(荷澤神會) played an important role in pacifying the Anshi Rebellion. And because of this, Huineng was officially granted the status of ‘Six Patriarchs’ by the state, and only then could the “the Platform Sutra of the Six Patriarch” officially emerge. However, in “the Platform Sutra of the Six Patriarch”, Confucianism's theory of personality and mind is used in terms of the theory of Buddha nature, which ultimately provided an important clue to the integration of Confucianism and Buddhism. And in Confucianism, LiangSu(梁肅) proposed ‘Fuxingmingjing(復性明靜)’ by conversing the Zhiguan(止觀) of Tiantai(天台) and the thought of Zhongyong(中庸). It was discussed that LiAo(李翶) realized the Chan principles of Southern Chan from YaoShanWeiYan(藥山惟儼) and discovered the theory of the return of nature and proposed the convergence of Confucianism and Buddhism.In addition, LiuZongYuan placed great importance on Tiantai studies to the extent that his name is listed in the Dharma lineages of the Tiantai sect. For this reason, LiuZongYuan presents the thought of convergence with Confucianism through the middle path, which is emphasized in Tiantai studies. Meanwhile, LiuZongYuan showed an attitude of criticizing Southern Chan style, which was popular at the time, but the epitaph of Huineng of the Sixth Patriarch contains a discussion of content that reconnects Southern Chan's thoughts with Confucianism.On the other hand, LiuYuXi was close to LiuZongYuan throughout his life, but ideologically he showed extreme importance to Southern Chan.LiuYuXi emphasized that Buddhism has ideas that make up for the shortcomings of Confucianism, and especially argued that thoughts of Southern Chan are like the sun that will brighten the long darkness for the Chinese people.The thought of contemporaneous Confucian scholars to integrate Buddhism and Confucianism played an important role in the emergence of ‘Lixue(理學)’ and ‘Xinxue(心學)’ in the Song Dynasty. Here convergence of Buddhism and Confucianism advocated by LiuZongYuan and LiuYuXi can be found to have important ideological and historical significance.
keywords_en: the interpenetration of Confucianism and Budhism
the Platform Sutra of the Six Patriarch

articles.title_kr: 수미산문 이엄선사의 사상과 그 배경 분석
articles.title_en: An Analysis of the Thoughts and Background of Master Lee um of Sumi Monastery
articles.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 고려 초기 수미산문의 창립자 이엄선사의 사상과 그 배경을 선사적 관점에서 분석하고 있다. 이엄선사는 달마선지, 도신, 홍인의 선맥을 잇고, 동산양개와 운거도응의 선법을 계승하여 선의정수를 고취하였다. 그는 당나라에서 깨달음을 얻은 후 고려로 돌아와 동아시아 불학사에서 ‘본성’ 자각의 선을 전승하고 확산시키며수미산문을 개척했다. 본 연구는 이엄의 유일한 비문을 통해 그의선지를 밝히고, 고려 초기 수미산문의 선법을 규명하고자 한다. 특히 수미산문이 선종의 주요 역할을 했다는 사실과 이엄이 달마의선풍, 동산의 법지, 조동선의 선지를 바탕으로 한 선수행을 발전시켰음을 강조하며, 그가 고려시대 선 사상사에서 새로운 지평을 열었음을 부각시키고자 한다.
keywords_kr: 廣照寺眞澈禪師寶月乘空塔碑銘
keywords_en: Inscription on the Pagoda of Venerable Zhin Chul Seon Master Baoyue Riding the Empty Tower at Guangzhao Temple (廣照寺眞澈 禪師寶月乘空塔碑銘)

articles.title_kr: 향가제작법에 의한 <보현십원가> 해독과 <보현십원가>가 여는 향가의 세계
articles.title_en: The decipherng of the Bohyeonsipwonga by the Hyangga production method & The world of the Hyangga
articles.abstract_kr: As a result of analyzing the characteristics of the characters marked with Hyangga, a method of producing Hyangga was derived.the method of producing Hyangga was derived is as follows.All characters functioned as ideogram or multifunctional characters.Hyangga characters are assembled into a song lyrics(歌言) + Cheongeon(請言) + Boeon(報言) structure to form a sentence.The lyrics of Hyangga are arranged in Korean order.Hyangga was a work that ancient people prayed for heaven and earth to make their wishes come true, and it was a work with the script character of ancient comprehensive art.Also, Hyangga was written to be read in Korean.The word “stem” was written to be read in meaning, and “postposition” or “the end of a word” was written to be read using the pronunciation of Chinese characters.

articles.title_kr: 동리산문의 인물과 사상
articles.title_en: Characters and Thoughts of Dongnisanmun [桐裏山門]
articles.abstract_kr: Dongnisanmun[桐裏山門] was opened by Jeok-In Hye-cheol at Taeansa Temple in Gokseong. The representative Zen monk of Dongnisanmun was Hye-cheol’s grand disciple, Yun-da. Also, as a collateral branch of Dongnisanmun, there was Doseon of Okryongsa Temple in Gwangyang and his disciple Gyeongbo[慶甫]. Dongnisanmun focused on Zen[禪] and also paid attention to teachings such as Hwaeom [華嚴]. In particular, Doseon was famous for his Feng Shui philosophy[風 水地理], and Gyeongbo also learned the Jodong Buddhism[曹洞宗].In 924, King Gyeongmyeong(r.917-924) erected the monuments of Simhui at Bongnimsa Temple in Changwon, Gyeongsang Province and Doheon at Bongamsa Temple in Mungyeong, Gyeongsang Province, and ordered the construction of an epitaph for Haengjeog at Taejasa Temple in Bonghwa, Gyeongsang Province. Also, in 924, he had Choi In-yeon (Choi Eon-wi) compose the epitaph for Jeoljung at Heungnyeongsa Temple in Yeongwol, Gangwon-do. Soon, King Gyeongmyeong took over the old Silla that connected Changwon-Mungyeong-Bonghwa-(Yeongwol) and tried to save Silla by dividing a country into three countries[天下三分] that recognized Wang Geon’s Goryeo and Gyeon Hwon’s Later Baekje.What was especially noteworthy this time was that in 924, the stone to be used for the monument of Doheon at Bongamsa Temple in Mungyeong was transported by ship from Hwasun[和順], Jeollanam-do to Mungyeong. This is an expansion of King Gyeongmyeong’s plan to divide the world into three regions, including the Later Baekje region of Jeolla Province. The transport of the monument was done with the consent of Wang Geon and Gyeon Hwon, who were competing for control over Naju and its surroundings. It also served as a performance for monks to divide a country into three countries. I think that Gyeongbo of Gwangyang Okryongsa Temple at Dongnisanmun, who returned to Impi-hyeon, Jeonju of Later Baekje in 921, played a significant role in this performance.
keywords_en: Dividing a country into three countries[天 下三分]

articles.title_kr: 사자산문 도윤과 절중의 선사상 소고
articles.title_en: A Study on the Seon-Thought of Sajasanmoon’s Do-yun and Jul-joong
articles.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 사자산문에서 핵심 인물이라고 할 수 있는 도윤과 절중의 선사상을 그들이 맞닥뜨렸던 시대적 상황을 통해 사유하고남아 있는 자료를 활용해 도윤과 절중의 선사상을 해석했다. 본연구는 크게 다음과 같은 세 가지 관점에서 접근되었다.첫째, 사자산문의 시대적 정치적 배경에 대해 논의했다. 도윤과 절중이 살았던 나말여초는 왕실세력과 지방세력이 갈등하고, 교종과선종이 대립하던 시기였다. 도윤이 국내에서 화엄을 공부하고 중국으로 유학을 갔던 시대와 사회는 정권이 교체되는 전란기였다. 왕실과 지방세력은 자신들의 정치적 입지를 세우고 새로운 사회를 건설하기 위한 새로운 사상을 갈구하고 있었다. 이때 당에서 유행하던 조사선법을 전해 받고 귀국한 도윤은 당시의 사회가 겪고 있던역사적 역할까지 요구받고 있었다. 절중 역시 마찬가지였다. 절중은 궁예와 견훤 그리고 왕건의 세력이 부딪히는 혼란기에서 안정적 이지 못한 생애를 보냈다. 이러한 때 그는 비록 도윤을 비롯한 당시의 선사들을 통해 선을 수행하고 깨침을 얻었지만, 선의 초월적인경지에 머무르기보다 현실적 적용을 고민했을 것이다.둘째, 도윤의 선사상에 대해 논의했다. 도윤의 선은 몇 가지 특징을갖고 있었다. 우선 도윤은 비록 화엄교학을 배웠지만 이에 만족하지 않고 ‘심인(心印)의 묘용(妙用)’을 구하고자 하였다. 또한 도윤은남전과 만나자마자 바로 ‘목격도존(目擊道存)’을 경험한다. 목격도존은 눈빛이 부딪히는 순간 이심전심(以心傳心)이 되었음을 의미한다.도윤은 기본적으로 남전의 선법을 계승했다. 남전의 선은 마조의선사상을 계승한 것으로 남전은 근원이나 실상에 대한 집착도 넘어있는 그대로의 생생한 작용 속에서 평상심을 실천할 것을 강조했다. 도윤은 남전의 작용을 중시하는 선법을 계승했을 것이다.셋째, 절중의 선사상에 대해 살펴보았다. 절중은 독립적이며 강한개성을 갖고 있었다. 이러한 절중의 선 사상을 크게 세 가지로 논의했다. 먼저, 절중은 자인선사와 만나 선문답을 했다. ‘절중’은 자신의 이름을 이용하여 근원적 세계에도 머물고 있지 않은 ‘현재적 자기’를 드러냈다. 다음으로, 절중은 다시 16년간의 보림을 통해 ‘득의망언(得意忘言)’이라는 선의 궁극적 경지에 도달했다. 절중이 증득한‘득의망언’은 언어를 초월해 절대적 세계에 도달하는 것을 의미하는것이 아니다. 그보다는 ‘득의’와 ‘망언’에도 머물지 않는 현재의 자기를 중시하는 것이다. 이를 통해 절중이 근원세계만을 강조하지 않고 선법에 기반한 다양한 교화방편을 수용하였음을 유추할 수 있다. 마지막으로, ‘즉범성성(卽凡成聖)’을 통해 절중의 선이 ‘즉범즉성(卽凡卽聖)’과 관련이 있음을 논의했다. ‘즉범성성’은 마조의 ‘즉심즉불’과 관련된다. ‘즉범즉성’은 말 그대로 범부가 성인이기 때문에 누구라도 왕이 될 수 있다는 함의를 가진다. 따라서 ‘범(凡)’과 ‘성(聖)’ 사이에 ‘성(成)’이라는 시간적 매개를 상징하는 동사로 대치되었을것이다. 나말여초에 조사선이 새로운 사상으로 환영받은 것은 사실이지만 개혁적 측면이 강했기 때문에 정치권력의 사상을 뒷받침하기에는 여전히 조심스러운 측면이 있었다. 이것은 절중이 혼란한시대를 살아가며 왕실과 지방세력 가운데서 균형을 맞추며 선법을진작시킨다는 것이 쉽지 않았음을 보여준다.
keywords_en: forget the words after attaining the truth
an ordinary one can become an enlightened person
an ordinary one is the enlightened person

articles.title_kr: 수미산문의 인물과 사상
articles.title_en: The Study on the Character and Thought of Sumi-san School
articles.abstract_kr: In this paper, I wrote the Character and Thought of Sumi-san School(수미산문). The first, I examined the significance of Sumi-san School. As a result, I thought that Sumeru Cosmology(수미산 세계관) influenced the name of Sumi-san School.Second, I examined who was the learned Seon Thought of Yunju Daoying(雲居道膺). Furthermore, I divided the historical background of the opening of Sumi-san School. As a result, opened the Sumi-san School suggested a deep connection with King Wang Geon(태조 왕건) of Goryeo dynasty. It was also pointed out that the people who loved the country were strongly emphasized in the Seon Thought of JinchulLeeEom(진철 이엄). Finally, I examined the significance of the inscription “Kokjunghangma(국중항마)”.
keywords_en: Sumeru Cosmology(수미산 세계관). Yunju Daoying(雲居道膺). King Wang Geon(태조 왕건). Jinchul- LeeEom(진철 이엄). Kokjunghangma(국중항마)

articles.title_kr: 천태 지의의 『금광명경문구』에 나타난 참회의 의미
articles.title_en: A study on the meaning of repentance in the Mungu of the Golden light-sutra by Tiantai Chi-i*
articles.abstract_kr: This study is on the meaning of repentance in the Mungu of the Golden light-sutra by Tiantai Chi-i.There are two commentaries on the Golden Light Sutra : the Hyeonui of the Golden light-sutra and the Mungu of the Golden light-sutra.which had been given lectures by Tiantai and recorded by his disciple Guanzheng.As they belong to the five important texts of the Tiantai Order, we can see that the Golden Light Sutra was a scripture that, along with the Lotus Sutra, has been considered very important in the Tiantai Order.In the 3rd Chapter of Repentance of the Mungu of the Golden light-sutra, there is an explanation of “repentance” that cannot be found in other writings of Tiantai. First, the meaning of repentance is explained in ten ways. Through the explanation, It emphasizes that everyone, from ordinary people to virtuous bodhisattvas, should repent and abolish their sins while vowing to attain the highest truth.Next, it also explains in detail the repentance according to practice steps. It details the repentance that must be done at all levels from ordinary beings to three vehicle practitioners and the highest bodhisattvas.Through this interpretation, the Mungu of the Golden light-sutra.breaks the prejudice that repentance is for deluded ordinary beings, and specifically proves that it is a necessary practice for all practitioners who have not achieved Buddhahood.The meaning of repentance as described above can be found in the early lectures of Tiantai, Chajeseonmun, and in the later lectures of Mahajigwan, but the most notable feature of the commentary on the ‘Repentance Chapter’ of the Mungu of the Golden light-sutra. is that it specifically shows the repentance of everyone, from ordinary beings to the highest practitioners.This perspective is significant in that it provides the fundamental reason for emphasizing the repentance in Tiantai practice theory.
keywords_en: the Mungu of the Golden light-sutra
the samatha-vipassana of the perfection and sudden

articles.title_kr: 지(止) 수행의 장애와 대치법 ― 원효의 『대승기신론소』와 쫑카빠의 『보리도차제광론』을 중심으로-
articles.title_en: Obstacles to Śamatha Practice and Their Remedies― A Comparative Study of Wonhyo’s Commentary on the Awakening of Faith and Tsongkhapa’s Great Treatise on the Stages of the Path to Enlightenmen-
articles.abstract_kr: This study is a comparative analysis of the obstacles and countermeasures in the practice of śamatha(止) as presented in Wonhyo’s Commentary on the Awakening of Faith in Mahāyāna(大乘起信論疏) and Tsongkhapa’s The Great Treatise on the Stages of the Path to Enlightenment(菩提道次第廣論). Despite being active in vastly different times and environments —7th-century Silla and 14th-century Tibet respectively —both scholars share the commonality of establishing comprehensive practice systems through detailed examinations of the challenges encountered during śamatha practice and their resolutions.Their respective texts, Commentary on the Awakening of Faith in Mahāyāna and The Great Treatise on the Stages of the Path to Enlightenment, both draw upon Yogācārabhūmi-śāstra’s Bodhisattva- bhūmi for defining śamatha and emphasize the role of mindfulness(smṛti) as a central method in its practice. However, Wonhyo expands śamatha beyond mere tranquility, integrating the function of insight into emptiness(śūnyatā) and extending its role to eliminating the fundamental afflictions of self-grasping(ātma-grāha) and dharma-grasping (dharma-grāha).In contrast, Tsongkhapa interprets śamatha as a state of balance between clarity and stability of focus on an object, while asserting that insight into emptiness is achieved through vipaśyanā(觀).This study identifies and examines the differences in their perspectives on the sequence and roles of śamatha and vipaśyanā, highlighting how these differences arise and their significance in understanding their respective practice frameworks.
keywords_en: Commentary on the Awakening of Faith in Mahāyāna
The Great Treatise on the Stages of the Path to Enlightenment(Lamrim Chenmo)

articles.title_kr: 부인사의 대지조성 방법과 가람배치 변화
articles.title_en: The Land Construction Method and Changes in Temple Layout of Buinsa as Seen through Archaeological and Documentary Materials
articles.abstract_kr: This study examines archaeological and documentary evidence related to Buinsa Temple in Daegu to investigate the temple’s name, methods of land construction, and changes in its layout over time.The temple’s name appears in documentary records as ‘夫人寺’, ‘夫仁 寺’, and ‘符仁寺’. This variation has hindered the consensus regarding Buinsa’s role as the enshrinement site for the first Tripitaka Koreana in the Goryeo period. However, during the ninth excavation, roof tiles inscribed with names like ‘夫○○’, ‘夫人○’, and ‘符仁寺’ were discovered, validating that all three names refer to the same Buinsa. This discovery also confirms that the current Buinsa was indeed the enshrinement site of the first Tripitaka Koreana.To date, nine excavations have been conducted at Buinsa, with six focusing on the Buddhist area where the main hall (金堂) of the Unified Silla period was located. This paper explores the land construction methods and layout changes, centering on Buinsa’s Buddhist area. In the method of constructing the site in the Bujji space of Bujisa Temple, a part of the slope was first excavated, stopped, and then partitioned. Next, some of the base layers were excavated in the east and south where the area was low along the partition to lay the lower foundation of the shaft. In addition, an axis was stacked to a certain height, and the designated layer was made flat by the soil and stone condensation method inside. After that, garams were partitioned from the designated layer, and the base layer and the designated layer were partially excavated to prepare the lower foundation of the shaft table. In addition, an axis was stacked to a certain height, and the base layer was made flat by the soil mixing method inside. Finally, brown sandy clay was laid over the base layer and stopped flat. The layout of the Buddhist area of Buinsa underwent continuous changes due to historical events such as the conflicts during the Later Three Kingdoms period, floods, invasions by Mongol forces, and the Japanese invasions of 1597 (Jeongyu War). These changes can be categorized into the founding period, three phases of reconstruction, and two phases of decline.

articles.title_kr: 이미지 비교·분석을 통한 금속 활자본, 번각 목판본, 중간 목판본 특징의 정량화와 고문헌 연구에서의 활용에 관한 제안
articles.title_en: Extraction of Printing Characteristics of Metal Type, Woodblock and Duplicated Woodblock through Image Comparison and Analysis for Historic Bibliographic Research
articles.abstract_kr: In this study, we collected images of various editions of the same old book, compared and analyzed the images, and applied it to the study of ancient literature by extracting the characteristics of prints using metal type and duplicated woodblocks. Images of several versions of Songja Daejeon (宋子大全) and The Five Confucian Virtues (五倫行實圖), printed using different techniques and times were collected, compared and analyzed. In the case of woodblock prints, it was discovered that they shrink in the range of 1.3~3.6% in the vertical direction due to shrinkage and deformation of the woodblock, depending on the printing period.When the original text is a metal type print and the duplicated versions are woodblock printed, it has been confirmed that the metal type versionis always longer in the vertical direction and the duplicated woodblock prints has shrunk in the vertical direction by up to 3.2% due to wood shrinkage. This is expected to be a useful phenomenon as it is a field of digital humanities based on comparison and analysis techniques of old book image databases and digital images.

articles.title_kr: 임진왜란기 충청지역 의승의 참전과 활동
articles.title_en: Battle of the Monks’ Militia of Chungcheong Province
articles.abstract_kr: The righteous army led by monks’ militia of monk Yeonggyu and the righteous army chief Cho Heon, who rose around Okcheon, Chungcheong-do, united to recapture Cheongju Castle and made a clear contribution in the battle of Yeongonpyeong, Geumsan Province, neutralizing Japanese troops trying to invade Chungcheong-do and Jeolla-do and driving them out.By Oh Hee-moon, it is said that Monks’ militia in Joseon in Chungcheong-do wins wherever he goes because he is not afraid of death and does not retreat. Representative temples of monks’ militia include Gonglimsa Temple in Goesan, Chungcheong-do, Juseongam Hermitage in Okcheon, and Beopjusa Temple. In addition to these temples, temples across the country set up a main camp, a righteous army camp, and a large place to participate in the battle.The case of monks’ militia in Chungcheong-do is as follows. Monk Gobong, Unil, and Jeolla-do, the chief executive of Chungcheong-do seems to have been under the command. monk Hongjeong and Seongjeong each have about 1,000 monks’ militia in Chungcheong-do. The appearance of Uiseung Cho-eon, the Beopjusa Temple of Songnisan, is found.In January 1594, the base of Song Yu-jin’s rebellion, which was centered on Asan and Jiksan, was Gaehyeonsa Temple in Asan, where monk Ilhyeon was active. monk Dohyeon belonged to the unit of monk Yeonggyu, and participated in the Battle of Cheongju and Geumsan, and was given the Korean language. The number of successive troops such as monk Neungun was close to 1,000. Seolmi, monks’ militia at Docheonsa Temple in Buyeo, was killed while trying to change her mind without sympathizing with Lee Mong-hak’s rebellion. It is said that monk Jeong Man-eok, monks’ militia, hit the enemy well, and there was a similar class.The members of monks’ militia of Gongseong recruited and repaired Gongju Fortress. Monks of Imcheon Bogwangsa Temple in Buyeo have also participated in the war as monks’ militia, and records on Muryangsa Temple in Buyeo are found. In addition, it is said that three monks’ militia from Daedunsan Mountain in Nonsan were killed while participating in the battle.

articles.title_kr: 보살도의 일상성
articles.title_en: The Mundanities of the Bodhisattva Path: The “Bodhisattva Prātimokṣa” and the Bodhisattva Ideal on the Ground in the Middle Period Mahāyāna
articles.abstract_kr: This paper studies the set of bodhisattva precepts that appears in the Bodhisattvabhūmi and is commonly known in East Asia as the “bodhisattva prātimokṣa.” After studying the history of the independent circulation of these precepts in India, China, Tibet, and Central Asia, I highlight their pedestrian and practical focus that would have contributed to their wide popularity in the Buddhist world. Building on this, I use these precepts to study the social and institutional actualities of bodhisattvas the authors of these precepts in Middle Period India presupposed. This examination will corroborate many elements of the forest hypothesis regarding the origin of Mahāyāna Buddhism and furthermore help us flesh out the profile of the bodhisattva practitioner in Middle Period India in richer and more realistic detail.

articles.title_kr: 신라성립의 제 경론
한류의 전지구화(global-localization)와  문화전이 현상
articles.title_en: Globalization and Cultural Transition of the Korean Wave

articles.title_kr: 여성문학 국제화의 힘: 환유와 상징
articles.title_en: The power of the Globalization of  Women's Literature : Metonymy and Symbol
articles.abstract_kr: 이 논문은 한국문학의 세계화에 기여한 두 사람의 작가에 관한 연구이다. 한 사람은 시인 김혜순이며, 다른 한 사람은 소설가 한강이다. 이들은 최근에 최고의 권위가 주어진 문학적 성취를 이루어놓았다. 김혜순은 구체적이고, 경험적이고, 또 감각적인 환유의 방식에 의거해 남성 중심의 사회를 비판하는 시를 써왔고, 한강은 문화를 열어놓는 힘인 이미지와 상징을 통해 신화의 세계와 현대소설의접목을 꾀하는 소설 쓰기를 추구해 왔다. 은유가 유사성의 원리에의거한 비유라면, 환유는 인접성의 원리에 충실한 비유다. 2025년에미국 아카데미 명예회원으로 선정된 시인 김혜순은 시의 방법론을환유에 두고 있다. 그의 시 작품인 ｢여자들｣, ｢색안경은 말한다｣, ｢날개 환상통｣ 등에서 살펴볼 수 있다. 2024년에 노벨문학상을 수상한 소설가 한강은 ‘상징으로서의’ 소설 읽기를 가능하게 해준다. 그의 소설 ｢내 여자의 열매｣는 신화적 상상력에 닿아있는 상징의전략을 구사했다. 또한 ｢흰｣에서는 흰색이 생명의 바탕색이요, 또입김이 원초적인 생명력이라는 사실을 잘 보여주고 있다. 김혜순은고대의 예언자-시인, 중세의 음유시인, 여성 전통의 여성 샤먼의이미지를 재현했다. 스웨덴 한림원에서는 한강의 작품 세계를 두고흰색은 죽음과 슬픔의 상징이며, 빨간색은 생명과 상처의 상징이라고 말했다.
articles.abstract_en: This paper is a study of two writers who have contributed to the globalization of Korean literature. One is the poet Kim Hyesoon, and the other is thee novelist Han Kang. Both have recently achieved the highest recognition in literary accomplishment. Kim Hyesoon has written poetry that critiques a male-centered society through the concrete, empirical, and sensory methods of metonymy. Han Kang, on the other hand, has pursued a style of novel writing that connects the world of myth with contemporary fiction through the use of images and symbols-forces that open up culture.While metaphor is a figure of speech based on the principle of similarity, metonymy is based on the priciple of contiguity. Kim Hyesoon, who was selected as an honorary member of the American Academy in 2025, bases her poetic methodology on metonymy. This can be observed in her works such as ‘Women’, ‘The Glasses Speak’ and ‘Winged Pseudo-disease’. Han Kang, who won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2024, enables the reading of the novel as symbol. Her novel ‘The Fruit of My Woman’ employs a symbolic strategy that touches upon mythological imagination.In ‘The White’, she effectively shows that white is the base color of life and that breath is a primal life force. Kim Hyesoon recreates the image of the ancient prophet-poet, the medieval troubadour, and the female shaman in the tradition of women. The Swedish Academy stated that in Han Kang’s literary world, white symbolizes death and sorrow, while red symbolizes life and wounds.

articles.title_kr: 역사한류와 한국문화,  《삼국유사》를 중심으로
articles.title_en: Korean Wave and Korean Culture,  Focusing on《Samguk Yusa》
articles.abstract_kr: 한류의 역사적 문화적 원천 가운데 하나인 《삼국유사》가 여러 나라말로 번역되면서 외국인들 사이에서도 이에 대한 관심이 높아지고있다. 외국인의 《삼국유사》 번역은 당연히 한국의 《삼국유사》 한글번역과 영역본의 해석을 참조하게 된다. 그렇다면 먼저 우리가 완벽한 《삼국유사》 한글 번역서와 영문 번역서를 만들도록 노력해야한다. 필자는 이 글에서 ‘인간’에 대한 바른 해석인 ‘인간세상’을 강조했다. 홍익인간은 인간[=사람]을 이롭게 하는 것이 아니라 ‘널리 ‘인간세상’을 이롭게 한다‘라는 뜻이다. 비록 5천년전의 통치이념이었지만21세기 기후와 환경 문제를 해결하는 절실한 해결방법이라고 생각된다. 세계로 뻗어가는 한류 현상 속에서 ’홍익인간‘이란 이념도 한류와 함께 세계인이 공유했으면 하는 생각이다.최근 국립중앙박물관에서는 가야실에 수로왕의 탄생과 건국을 말하면서 《삼국유사》의 수로의 탄생과 건국 신화를 부연 설명하였다.당연히 고조선실에도 《삼국유사》에 나오는 단군의 탄생과 고조선의 건국신화를 실으면서 ‘널리 인간 세상을 이롭게 하다’라는 홍익인간을 덧붙여 주었으면 한다.K-한류는 한국문화의 특수성과 보편성을 적절히 활용해야 한다.21세기 단군신화가 주목받지 못한 이유 가운데 하나가 단군신화를민족 신화라는 특수성에 가둬두었기 때문이다. 이 글에서는 21일과100일을 통해 ‘과정 속의 인간’이란 보편적 측면과 ‘곰과 범의 사랑’ 이란 새로운 이야기로 단군신화를 해석해 보았다. 또 비형이 세운‘귀교’란 이름을 외국인이 한국에 들어오려면 꼭 건너야만 하는 인천대교를 Ghost Bridge란 이름으로 지어 보았다.한류가 한때의 흐름으로 남지 않고 지속적으로 유지되기 위해서는《삼국유사》 등 한국 고전에 대한 새로운 관점에서의 재해석이 계속되어야 한다고 생각한다.
articles.abstract_en: As one of the historical and cultural sources of the Korean Wave, 《Samguk Yusa》 has been translated into many languages, interest in it is increasing among foreigners. Foreigners’ translations of 《Samguk Yusa》 naturally refer to the Korean translations of 《Samguk Yusa》 and the interpretations of the English versions. If so, we should first strive to create perfect Korean and English translations of 《Samguk Yusa》. In this article, the author emphasized the correct interpretation of ‘human’, ‘human world or the world of human beings.’ Hongik Ingan does not mean benefiting humans [=people], but rather ‘broadly benefiting the ‘human world’. Although it was a ruling ideology from 5,000 years ago, I think it is an urgent solution to solving the climate and environmental problems of the 21st century. As the Korean Wave phenomenon spreads around the world, I hope that the ideology of ‘Hongik Ingan’ will be shared by people around the world along with the Korean Wave. Recently, the National Museum of Korea explained the birth and foundation of King Suro in the Gaya Room while adding the birth and foundation myth of Suro in the Samguk Yusa. Naturally, I hope that the Gojoseon Room will also include the birth of Dangun and the foundation myth of Gojoseon in the Samguk Yusa while adding the Hongik Ingan, which means “to benefit the human world widely.” K-Hallyu should appropriately utilize the uniqueness and universality of Korean culture. One of the reasons why the Dangun myth has not received attention in the 21st century is because it has been confined to the uniqueness of a national myth. In this article, I have interpreted the Dangun myth through the universal aspect of ‘humans in the process’ and the new story of ‘the love of a bear and a tiger’ through 21 days and 100 days. I also tried to name Incheon Bridge, which foreigners must cross when they come to Korea, Ghost Bridge, after the name ‘Gwigyo’ by Bihyeong.In order for the Korean Wave to continue and not remain as a passing trend, I believe that new perspectives on Korean classics such as Samguk Yusa must continue to be interpreted.
keywords_en: the love of a bear and a tiger

articles.title_kr: 철학 한류와 한국 문화
articles.title_en: Korean Philosophy Wave and Korean Culture
articles.abstract_kr: 이 논문은 분황 원효(617~686)와 보조 지눌(1158~1210), 퇴계 이황(1501~1570)과 율곡 이이(1536~1584) 철학에 대한 해외 한국학 연구를검토하여 한류의 최후이자 정점으로 판단되는 철학 한류와 한국 문화의 어제와 오늘을 성찰하기 위한 글이다. 한류(Korean Wave)는 처음에 K-드라마/시네마가 선편을 잡았지만 이후 한류는 전 세계를무대로 하여 K-팝으로 이어지면서 큰 물살을 타기 시작하였다. 이에 힘입어 한류는 K-컬처로서 한식, 한복, 한옥, 뷰티, 등산, 방산등이 널리 알려지면서 중류나 일류와 차별화되었다. 2025년 현재한 세대의 역사를 지나는 한류는 1단계와 2단계를 넘어 3단계를 거쳐 마지막 4단계의 K-클래식으로 이어지고 있다.논자는 현재의 단계에서 인문 한류의 기반을 이루고 있는 ‘철학 한류’의 현황과 과제를 한국의 철학자이자 사상가인 불교의 원효와 지눌, 유교의 이황과 이이에 대한 해외 한국학 연구를 통해 구명해보았다. 이들 철학자들은 모두 상구보리와 하화중생, 자기 수양과외적 구원을 향한 위기지학(爲己之學)의 길을 걸어갔던 수행자(경학자)이자 경세가였다. 그렇다면 이들의 이름으로 대표되는 철학 한류가 현재의 한류 흐름을 조금 더 확장하고 보다 더 활성화하기 위한 실질적이고 실천적인 방안으로는 어떤 것이 있을까.철학 한류의 물결을 좀더 타기 위해서는 제도권 철학자들이 인간이해와 세계 인식을 통해 자아를 세계화하고 세계를 자아화하는 철학의 본령을 되찾아야 한다. 그리하여 만학의 제왕이었던 철학이미학 윤리학 종교학 언어학 등으로 분봉해 주었던 탈영토화된 철학의 영토를 재영토화하면서 시대정신과 역사의식에 기초한 담론으로철학하는 삶의 철학으로 탈바꿈해야 한다. 이를 위해 국내외 한국학을 활성화하기 위해서는 다음과 같은 몇 가지 노력이 요청된다.첫째, 해외 한국학 연구들의 한국 철학에 대한 왜곡 여부와 새로운해석이 있는지에 대한 검토도 이루어져야 한다. 둘째, 해외 한국학의 활성화를 위해 한국학 연구를 위한 해외 사립대학 및 주립대학의 한국학연구소 개소와 연구를 위한 기금을 확보해야 한다. 셋째, 해외 한국학의 확산을 위해 주요 철학자들의 저술에 대한 번역과연구를 지속적으로 뒷받침할 수 있는 제도적 장치가 마련되어야 한다. 넷째, 이러한 물적 토대와 인적 토대의 기반 위에서 이들 철학자들의 사상에 대한 보다 깊이 있는 분석이 필요하다.
articles.abstract_en: This paper reflects on the past and present of the “Korean Philosophy Wave” and Korean culture, which I regard as the final and culminating phase of the broader Korean Wave. To this end, I examine overseas Korean studies on the philosophies of Bunhwang Wonhyo (617–686) and Bojo Jinul (1158–1210) in Buddhism, as well as Toegye Yi Hwang (1501 1570) and Yulgok Yi I (1536–1584) in Confucianism.The Korean Wave first emerged through K-dramas and cinema. As of 2025, it has gained global momentum, particularly through K-pop.Building on this popularity, the Korean Wave has expanded into K-culture, encompassing Korean cuisine (hansik), traditional attire (hanbok), architecture (hanok), beauty, hiking culture, and even the military industry —marking a clear distinction from the Chinese and Japanese Waves.Having passed through its first, second, and third phases, the Korean Wave is now entering its fourth and final stage: the rise of K-Classic.Nevertheless, I argue that the fourth stage of the Korean Wave—represented by the Korean Literature Wave and Korean History Wave— points toward its ultimate culmination in the Korean Philosophy Wave.By focusing on the present status and future challenges of overseas research on Korean philosophy, particularly regarding the representative thinkers Wonhyo, Jinul, Yi Hwang, and Yi I, this paper investigates the foundations of the Korean Humanities Wave.These philosophers, who pursued both personal enlightenment and the salvation of all beings, can be described as contemplative scholars and theorists who sought universal truth through rigorous self-discipline.In this context, I explore how the Korean Philosophy Wave, associated with these figures, might be expanded and activated as a concrete and practical extension of the broader Korean Wave.For philosophy to ride the tide of the Korean Wave, institutional philosophers must reclaim the original domain of philosophy—once considered the sovereign discipline of all studies—by deepening human understanding and insights into the world. Philosophy should be reconstituted as a discourse grounded in the spirit of the age and historical consciousness, encompassing ethics, aesthetics, religion, and language.Moreover, as a worldview that comprehensively embraces all domains of knowledge, philosophy must aim to grasp the entirety of the world through self-understanding.To further invigorate Korean studies domestically and internationally, the following efforts are essential: A critical examination of potential distortions and novel interpretations in overseas research on Korean philosophy; The establishment of Korean Studies Institutes at private and public universities abroad, along with securing research funding; Institutional support for the translation and study of major works by Korean philosophers to facilitate the spread of Korean studies globally; In-depth analysis of the thought of major Korean philosophers based on solid material and human resources.

articles.title_kr: 종교 한류와 한국 문화
articles.title_en: K-Religion and Korean Culture
articles.abstract_kr: 전 세계적으로 K-팝과 K-드라마가 강세이다. 최근에는 ‘K-민주주의’라는 말까지 나올 정도이다. 하지만 아직 한국의 철학이나 사상은 해외에 거의 알려지지 않은 상황이다. 반면에 최근에 서양에서는 기후 위기 문제가 대두됨에 따라 비유럽 지역의 ‘토착적 세계관’ 에 주목하기 시작했다. 그렇다면 한국의 토착 사상이나 자생 종교도 오늘날의 위기 극복을 위해 요청되는 사상이 될 수 있지 않을까? 그리고 그것을 통해서 다른 문화권의 철학이나 종교와의 대화를 시도해 볼 수 있지 않을까? 이 글은 이러한 문제의식에서 19세기 말~20세기 초에 한국에서 탄 생한 동학과 원불교에 주목하였다. 동학은 인간을 인간 이외의 존재와의 관계 속에서 새롭게 규정함으로써 인간중심주의에서 벗어나고자 하였다. 존재론적으로는 인간과 만물을 동등하게 존엄한 ‘하늘’로 규정하면서, 만물을 공경하는 ‘경물(敬物)’의 단계에 도달해야비로소 ‘도덕(道德)’이 완성된다고 하는 포스트휴먼 도덕론을 제창하였다. 특히 최시형이 설파한 “하늘이 하늘을 먹는다”는 사상은 인간도 다른 종(species)의 먹이가 될 수 있음을 일깨워주면서, 인간의 위상을 지구공동체 내의 다른 존재들과 동등하게 자리매김하고 있다.한편 원불교를 창시한 소태산에 이르면 인공물에 대한 외경이 강조되면서, 기술을 대하는 새로운 도덕의 가능성을 보여준다. 이처럼동학과 원불교에서의 ‘도덕’의 전환은 인류세 시대에 요청되는 사상적 요소를 지니고 있고, 그런 점에서 다른 문화권의 철학과 소통할수 있는 여지가 풍부하다.
articles.abstract_en: While K-pop and K-drama have achieved global prominence, and even the term “K-democracy” has recently emerged, Korean philosophy and indigenous thought remain relatively unknown internationally. In response to the escalating climate crisis, Western academia has begun to explore non-European “indigenous worldviews,” raising the question of whether Korea’s indigenous traditions and self-generated religions might offer valuable resources for addressing contemporary crises and engaging in intercultural philosophical dialogue. This study focuses on Donghak and Won Buddhism, both of which emerged in Korea during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. Donghak sought to transcend anthropocentrism by redefining the human being within a network of relations with non-human existents. Ontologically, it positioned humans and all beings as equally sacred manifestations of “Heaven,” proposing a post-humanist ethics in which true morality is realized through reverence for all things(gyeongmul). Notably, Choe Si-hyeong’s teaching that “Heaven eats Heaven” implies that humans, too, may become sustenance for other species, situating humanity as an equal member of the Earth community.In parallel, Sot’aesan, the founder of Won Buddhism, emphasized reverence toward all phenomena, including artificial objects, thus suggesting new ethical frameworks for engaging with technological artifacts. The reconfiguration of morality in Donghak and Won Buddhism offers rich conceptual resources relevant to the Anthropocene and presents significant potential for dialogue with global philosophical and religious discourses.

articles.title_kr: 한류와 K팝의 뿌리 불교 악가무
articles.title_en: The Roots of Korean Wave and  K-Pop Buddhist Music and Dance
articles.abstract_kr: 본고에서는 한국의 불교 악가무가 한류의 뿌리가 되었음을 음악사를 통해 고찰하였다. 불교와 함께 서역음악이 중국에 전래되면서중국 문화 전반에 유연성을 더했다면 한국은 범어와 같은 소리글자로 인해 음악과 춤이 지닌 역동성의 기폭제가 되었다. 인도, 중앙아시아를 비롯한 다층의 문화를 흡수하며 신라에 이른 악가무가 향토화되었음을 崔致遠의 鄕樂雜詠五首를 통해 확인하였고, 원효의 무애가에 나무아미타불을 노래하며 따랐던 민중은 21세기 ‘코리안 떼창’ 이 되어 한류의 아이콘이 되었다. 여기에는 ‘우리’라는 어우러짐의심성을 지닌 한국인이 메기고 받으며 노래해온 한국 민요의 바탕이있었다.고려조의 팔관회와 연등회에서는 궁중악사들과 민간인이 함께하는산대 백희잡기가 성행했다. 이 무렵 한국 고유의 무속도 불교를 모방했으므로 오늘날 무가와 불교음악이 상통하는 점이 많다. 조선조의 세종임금이 창제한 정간보는 소리글자인 우리말의 역동성과 주체성이 만들어낸 결과였다. 󰡔악학궤범󰡕에서 백성의 소리에 32妙應하는한글 唱詞는 부처님의 32상호와 일치하고, 이를 半切한 세조의 16정간은 16梵字 다라니와 世間大人의 治世念願과 더불어 리듬절주의 기능적 표기였다. 이후 한국음악의 역동성은 繁音促節을 거듭하여 전통가곡, 시조, 巫歌와 회심곡을 관통하는 8박 절주가 되었다.조선 중기 이후 궁중에서 불교음악을 연주할 수 없게 되자 제반의불교음악이 민요 혹은 민간 예술음악으로 전환되었다. 장엄염불 가사였던 ‘江江水月來’가 ‘강강술래’ 민요가 되었는가하면 사찰 불교악가무는 유랑예인들의 연희가 되어 한류와 K팝의 원동력이 되었다.이제 음악 이론을 몰라도 AI를 통해 작곡을 할 수 있는 시대가 되었다. 21세기를 리더하는 K불교 악가무가 되기 위해서는 한국불교음악의 역사·문화적 배경에 대한 깊은 이해가 있어야 한국적 고유성이살아있는 불교음악을 생성할 수 있다. 한국불교의 정체성에 기반한심미적 감각과 창의성이 미래 K부디즘의 성공의 열쇠가 될 것이다.
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, I researched the produce that Korean Buddhist music and dance became the root of the Korean Wave and K-pop through the historical flow of music that runs through India, China, and Korea. While Indian and middle Asia music was introduced to China along with Buddhism, flexibility was added to the overall Chinese culture, and Korea became a catalyst for the dynamism of music and dance due to its phonetic script, such as Sanskrit. Silla unified the three kingdoms and absorbed the multi-layered cultures of the Three Kingdoms, India, and Central Asia, and made Buddhist culture flourish. At that time, the people who sang Namu Amitabha Buddha and followed Wonhyo’s Muaega(無碍歌). It became the 21st century “Ttechang(Sing along)” and became the icons of the Korean Wave. There was the DNA of Koreans who had a culture of harmony called “us”.In the Goryeo Dynasty’s Palgwanhoe(八關會) and Yeondeunghoe(燃燈 會), the Sandae Baekhee(山臺百戲)with various performances was popular. The Palgwahoe, which was originally a ritual performed to local gods, was transformed into a Buddhist ritual and Korean shamanism imitated Buddhism. As the result today’s Korean shaman songs and Buddhist music have many similarities. During the Joseon Dynasty, King Sejong created Jeongganbo with 32 spaces, a musical notation that could indicate the length of notes, also connected to the 32 holy and wise aspects of the Buddha. The 32-jeongganbo was changed to 16-jeonggan by King Sejo, making it a more functional musical notation, and is still being passed down today as traditional Korean music with the common characteristic of 8 beats like Sijo, traditional lyric songs, shamanic songs etc.Since the mid-Joseon Dynasty, when Buddhist music was not allowed to be performed in the royal court, various Buddhist ritual music and dancing of the Goryeo Dynasty, permeated the public and transformed into folk songs or general performing arts. Buddhist ritual music and dance at temples became the performances of traveling entertainers and became the driving force of Hallyu and K-pop. However, since music and dance that has lost its Buddhist identity cannot be called Buddhism, we need to be wary of the negative effects that hinder religious dharma. In order to become a K-Buddhism that leads the 21st century, dharma and sincerity that transcend the secular world are vital.
keywords_en: The history of Korean Buddhist Music

articles.title_kr: 『삼국유사 』에 의한  가야 불교 전래 시기 검토
articles.title_en: A Review of the Period of  Buddhism’s Transmission to Gaya  According to the Samguk Yusa
articles.abstract_kr: 󰡔삼국유사󰡕 ｢가락국기｣의 건국 기사, 도읍 기사, 허황옥 관련 기사, ｢금관성파사석탑｣조, ｢어산불영｣조의 기록을 원문에 충실하게 해독하면, 가야 불교의 전래 시기를 1세기로 볼 수 있다.구지가는 신나라가 망하자 한반도 남부로 이주한 김수로왕이 토착세력에게 요구한 충성 맹세였고, 건국 기사의 내용은 김수로왕이토착인들의 복골 의식을 이용하여 민중의 광범위한 지지를 도모하는 과정이다. 이는 한반도 남부에서 상대적으로 풍부하게 발견되는新錢, ｢문무대왕릉비문｣, ｢대당고김씨부인묘명｣, 이들 비문을 뒷받침하는 󰡔삼국사기󰡕와 󰡔삼국유사󰡕의 기사에 의해 입증된다.허황옥 도래 기사 등 허황옥 관련 기사로 허황옥을 실존 인물로 볼수 있고, 논란이 되는 ｢금관성파사석탑｣조 문구의 내용은, 허씨 집단의 도래와 함께 불교가 당연히 전래되었음을 전제로, ｢가락국기｣ 에 당시에 절을 창건했다는 기록이 없는 이유를 설명한 것이다. ｢가락국기｣ 도읍기사와 ｢어산불영｣조에 근거한다면 김수로왕이 불교신자였을 가능성도 있다.가야 불교 전래를 4~5세기로 보는 견해는 1세기 가야 고분군의 부재를 근거로 󰡔삼국유사󰡕 기록을 부정하는데, 이는 초기 고분의 소실 가능성이나 미발견 가능성을 간과한 성급한 추론으로 보인다.
articles.abstract_en: If we faithfully interpret the records from the “Garak-gukgi” in the Samguk Yusa, including the founding account, the capital establishment account, articles related to Heo Hwang-ok, the “Geumgwanseong Pasa Stone Pagoda” section, and the “Eosan Bulyeong” section according to their original texts, the transmission of Buddhism to Gaya can be dated to the 1st century.The Guji-ga was a loyalty oath that King Kim Suro demanded from indigenous forces after he migrated to the southern part of the Korean Peninsula following the fall of the Xin Dynasty. The content of the founding account describes the process by which King Kim Suro sought widespread popular support by utilizing the indigenous people’s bok-gol ritual. This is substantiated by the Xin coins found relatively abundantly in the southern part of the Korean Peninsula, the “Inscription on King Munmu’s Tomb,” the “Epitaph of Lady Daedang Go Kim,” and the records in the Samguk Sagi and Samguk Yusa that support these inscriptions.Based on the account of Heo Hwang-ok’s arrival, Heo Hwang-ok can be regarded as a historical figure. The content of the “Geumgwanseong Pasa Stone Pagoda” section presupposes that Buddhism was naturally transmitted along with the arrival of the Heo clan, and explains why there is no record in the “Garak-gukgi” of temple construction at that time.Based on the capital establishment account in the “Garak-gukgi” and the “Eosan Bulyeong” section, there is also a possibility that King Kim Suro was a Buddhist believer.The view that places the transmission of Buddhism to Gaya in the 4th-5th centuries negates the records of the Samguk Yusa based on the absence of 1st-century Gaya tomb complexes, but this is a hasty inference that overlooks the possibility of loss or undiscovery of early burial styles.
keywords_kr: 금관성파사석탑조의 海東末有創寺奉法之事
keywords_en: The historicity of the Gaya founding account in the “Garak-gukgi
“海東末有創寺奉法之事” in the Geumgwanseong Pasa Stone Pagoda section
